highlights: 本周视觉/多模态以17篇论文居首，词频权重2.0，与高效模型共现5次最高。
评测/基准（8篇）与安全/对齐（7篇）主题位列第二、三位，共现4次，显示可靠性评估受重视。
rising_topics: 视觉/多模态持续主导，且与高效模型、NLP、RAG等主题交叉加深（共现分别为5、4、3）。
脑相关词eeg（20次）与neural（18次）在词频中排名靠前，神经解码方向热度上升。
评测/基准（8篇）与安全/对齐（7篇）计数稳定，但共现关系增强，预示多模态可靠性与安全评估成为新焦点。

最后关注安全/对齐与评测论文（2608.04509、2608.10708）以理解风险约束与基准设计。
caveats: 数据仅来自arxiv单一来源，可能未覆盖所有相关论文。

interpretation.weekly_summary: 本周共收录36篇论文，平均分6.97，研究热点集中在视觉/多模态（17篇）、评测/基准（8篇）与安全/对齐（7篇）。词频与共现分析显示，视觉多模态与高效模型（共现5次）、NLP/语言（4次）、RAG/检索（3次）等主题交叉紧密；同时，EEG、neural等神经相关词高频出现，表明神经解码与脑机接口是本周重要方向。代表论文如2608.11656利用连续潜变量预测与语义对齐构建EEG-语言基础模型，实现跨被试神经解码；2608.07393采用联邦学习分解站点效应，建模脑动态功能连接；2608.09331结合检索增强生成实现忠实的脑到音频重建。此外，3D视觉与多视图几何约束研究突出，如2608.10708无标注测试时适应保证几何一致的3D视觉基础模型，2608.09110提出视图自适应渲染实现视图一致的2D到3D生成。高效模型、推理等上下文主题与视觉多模态的共现表明效率与推理能力正融入多模态系统。整体上，本周呈现跨模态神经解码与视觉多模态表征学习深度融合的趋势。
interpretation.weekly_summary_note: 本周小结由 deepseek-v4-pro 生成。
interpretation.monthly_summary: 本周视觉/多模态以17篇论文居首，词频权重2.0，与高效模型共现5次最高。 3篇9.0分论文聚焦脑解码与神经对齐：2608.11656、2608.07393、2608.09331。 评测/基准（8篇）与安全/对齐（7篇）主题位列第二、三位，共现4次，显示可靠性评估受重视。
watchlist: 脑机接口与语言模型对齐：关注连续潜变量预测、语义对齐在EEG-语言模型中的泛化与跨被试鲁棒性。
多视图几何约束：跟踪无标注测试时适应在3D视觉基础模型中的发展，以及2D到3D生成的视图一致性方法。
跨模态生成与检索增强：RAG在脑信号到音频/文本重建中的忠实度提升值得关注。
高效模型与视觉多模态融合：知识蒸馏（如网格保持蒸馏）在数据稀缺下的视觉Transformer训练，及其与多模态结合。
医疗影像联邦学习：跨站点/跨队列的fMRI动态连接建模与通用脑表征学习，涉及隐私和泛化。
安全/对齐与评测基准在多模态模型中的交叉：如CARGO-VL的反事实仲裁与风险约束优化，可能成为评测新范式。
预测编码与类脑推理：从分层惊奇级联到生物合理机器学习，或影响推理模型设计。
跨模态表征对齐：双空间一致性、文本嵌入模型变换等在脑机与跨模态检索中的迁移。

papers.title: Continuous-Latent Predictive Modeling with Semantic Alignment for EEG-Language Foundation Models
papers.title_zh: 面向脑电-语言基础模型的连续潜在预测建模与语义对齐
papers.evidence: EEG-语言基础模型，实现跨被试神经解码与脑-语言对齐
papers.tldr: 针对现有EEG预训练范式在语义对齐和连续动态建模上的不足，本文提出脑潜在预测模型（BLPM），将异构EEG解码任务统一为连续语义嵌入预测。通过连续EEG潜在预测编码器学习可迁移表示，结合多查询语义分解模块对齐EEG表示与文本语义。实验表明模型跨任务泛化性能一致，验证了连续潜在语义预测作为EEG-语言基础模型的有效性。
papers.abstract: Recent advances in EEG foundation models have demonstrated the potential of large-scale pretraining to enable generalizable neural decoding across subjects, recording environments, and datasets. papers.title: FedDOSE: Federated Learning Framework Decomposing Site Effects for Modeling Brain Dynamic Functional Connectivity
papers.title_zh: FedDOSE：用于大脑动态功能连接建模的站点效应分解联邦学习框架
papers.evidence: 跨站点/跨被试的fMRI动态功能连接建模
papers.tldr: 针对多中心fMRI数据联邦学习中站点异质性和动态功能连接信息缺失问题，提出FedDOSE框架。该框架通过模块化引导的Tucker分解编码动态功能连接，并利用最优传输与Procrustes分析对齐全局类原型，显式分解站点效应。在ABIDE和ADHD-200等数据集上诊断自闭症和注意缺陷多动障碍，性能超越现有方法，证明其从多站点数据学习鲁棒表征的有效性。
papers.abstract: Functional Magnetic Resonance Imaging ( fMRI ) data are often pooled into collaborative multi-site consortia, as deep learning models for analyses require large datasets to generalize well. papers.title: RAG-Audio: Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Faithful Brain-to-Audio Reconstruction
papers.title_zh: RAG-Audio：面向忠实脑到音频重建的检索增强生成
papers.evidence: fMRI脑到音频解码
papers.tldr: RAG-Audio提出一种检索增强生成方法，解决脑到音频重建中的“先验主导”问题：当预训练生成器仅依赖于弱神经信号时，会产生逼真但不准确的音频。通过从fMRI信号解码语义音频嵌入，检索匹配的真实音频样本，并用该样本初始化生成器的采样轨迹，同时保留解码嵌入作为条件，有效提升了刺激识别率并大幅降低了音频失真，表明检索引导初始化可缓解先验主导。
papers.abstract: Brain-to-audio reconstruction is limited by \emph{prior domination}: when a pretrained generator is conditioned on a weak neural signal, it produces realistic but stimulus-inaccurate audio. We introduce RAG-Audio, which decodes fMRI into a semantic audio embedding, retrieves a matching real-audio exemplar, and initializes the frozen generator's sampling tra...

papers.title: A Multi-Scale Temporal Framework with Dynamic Fusion for EEG-Based Emotion Recognition
papers.title_zh: 面向基于脑电的情绪识别的多尺度时间动态融合框架
papers.evidence: 基于EEG的情绪解码且采用跨被试协议，匹配脑解码需求
papers.tldr: 针对混合情绪识别研究不足及EEG单一时间窗口局限，本文提出多尺度时间框架：将EEG分解为多时长窗口，经共享注意力编码器处理，再由动态融合模块按样本分配权重。在独立被试协议下，二分类与三分类任务最佳准确率分别为65.22%和45.43%，均优于全信号基线，且最优时间尺度因任务而异。
papers.abstract: Mixed emotions represent a clinically relevant but still underexplored target for automatic emotion recognition. EEG provides millisecond-level access to neural activity, yet most EEG pipelines analyze the signal through a single temporal window, thereby fixing the temporal structure available to the model. This study introduces a multi-scale temporal frame...

papers.title: A foundation-model approach to pediatric headache classification from rs-fMRI
papers.title_zh: 基于基础模型的儿童头痛分类：从静息态功能磁共振成像的方法
papers.evidence: 使用rs-fMRI进行儿童头痛分类的脑解码
papers.tldr: 儿童头痛是常见神经系统疾病，影响生活质量。本研究利用静息态功能磁共振成像和基础模型NeuroSTORM进行头痛分类，相比传统功能连接矩阵方法，在区分头痛与非头痛及亚型分类上表现更优，验证了fMRI预测儿童头痛的可行性，为个体化治疗提供可能。
papers.abstract: Headache is the most common neurological disorder in children and substantially affects quality of life. We investigated whether resting-state functional MRI (rs-fMRI) can support pediatric headache classification using machine learning. papers.title: GenFAR: A generalized representation of brain structure, derived from 49,246 multi-cohort MRIs via deep learning
papers.title_zh: GenFAR：基于深度学习从49,246例多队列MRI得出的脑结构广义表征
papers.evidence: 用49246例跨队列MRI学习通用脑表征以提升泛化
papers.tldr: 针对传统神经影像深度学习模型任务单一、知识迁移受限的问题，本文提出GenFAR模块化深度学习框架。该框架在49,246例多队列脑MRI上通过17项临床相关任务进行顺序学习，得到通用脑结构表示。通过分析5000个任务序列确定最优序列长度为6，并识别出五个强供体任务（年龄、AD/MCI、MMSE、高血压、高脂血症）。实验表明该表示可迁移至训练集外任务，显著提升下游模型的样本效率和准确率。
papers.abstract: Deep learning models for neuroimaging have largely been developed for individual tasks, limiting knowledge transfer across applications. Here we introduce GenFAR, a modular deep learning framework that learns general, clinically informed features from brain MRIs. We trained this modular architecture on 49,246 individuals across 11 cohorts, using 17 diverse...

papers.title: LEGO: Leveled Language Gaussian Splatting

papers.evidence: 将多视图SAM粒度重分级为统一的三维一致层次结构，并用CLIP嵌入接地
papers.tldr: 针对开放词汇3D场景理解中语义层次缺失问题，本文提出LEGO方法。通过自适应重分级多视角SAM分割粒度生成3D一致的层次结构，并用CLIP嵌入和空间关系构建层级语言场景图，赋能大模型进行空间推理。LEGO在多种3D分割基准上取得最优性能，展现了先进的层次场景理解能力。

Beyond basic concept recognition, its core innovation lies in capturing the intrinsic semantic hierarchies within the scene, such as the "flowerpot -> bouquet -> bud -> petal" lineage. papers.title_zh: 超越时间的循环神经网络：从多个有序投影中学习
papers.evidence: 多个有序投影揭示序列模型中的互补结构依赖
papers.tldr: 本文提出有序结构依赖假说（OSDH），认为同一观测的多种排序可揭示互补结构依赖；据此设计独立结构专家原则（ISEP），实现 SE-RNN：多个 RNN 作为投影专家独立训练后融合表示。实验表明在含隐藏结构依赖的数据上一致获益，简单数据仍具竞争力，且框架可扩展至非 RNN 架构。
papers.abstract: Recurrent neural networks (RNNs) are widely used for sequence learning, yet their application is commonly associated with temporal data, although recurrent computation fundamentally operates on ordered sequences rather than on time itself. Building on this observation, we introduce the Ordered Structural Dependency Hypothesis (OSDH), which proposes that mul...

papers.title: Self-Geometry: GT-Free and Plug-and-Play Test-Time Adaptation for Geometrically Consistent 3D Vision Foundation Models
papers.title_zh: Self-Geometry：面向几何一致的3D视觉基础模型的无真值即插即用测试时自适应
papers.evidence: 三维视觉基础模型的多视图几何一致性约束
papers.tldr: 3D视觉基础模型单次前向预测深度、姿态和点图，但预训练未施加显式多视图几何约束，导致不一致。本文提出Self-Geometry，一种免真值、即插即用的测试时自适应方法，利用2D像素对应作为伪真值，通过几何解耦优化（结合多视图一致性与极线一致性损失并梯度解耦）、基于SO(3)测地距离的视图采样和LoRA轻量适配，在多个模型与基准上一致提升姿态和几何估计。
papers.abstract: Recent Vision Foundation Models (VFMs) predict depth, camera pose, and pointmap in a single forward pass without per-scene optimization, achieving strong generalization. However, enforcing explicit multi-view geometric consistency, e.g., through bundle adjustment, is computationally costly and is thus not imposed during VFM pretraining, so such inconsistenc...

papers.title: View-Adaptive Renderer for View-Consistent 2D-to-3D Generation
papers.title_zh: 视角自适应渲染器，用于视角一致的二维到三维生成
papers.evidence: 提出视图自适应渲染以实现视图一致的2D到3D生成，是一种多视图结构约束方法
papers.tldr: 传统单图像3D重建常因视图间不一致导致精度不佳，现有方法或计算昂贵或效果有限。本文提出视点自适应神经渲染框架，通过视点自适应渲染器独立校正各视图误差，并利用自注意力融合模块保证几何一致性，在仅使用光度损失和轻量正则化的情况下，实现接近最优的重建保真度，兼具高效与准确性。
papers.abstract: Reconstructing 3D shapes from a single image remains a fundamental yet challenging problem in computer vision. Traditional monocular 3D generation pipelines typically synthesize multiple views from a single input image before applying Neural Radiance Field (NeRF)-based reconstruction. However, inherent projective ambiguities often produce visual discontinui...

papers.title: CARGO-VL: Counterfactual Arbitration with Risk-Constrained Group Optimization for Vision-Language Models
papers.title_zh: CARGO-VL：面向视觉-语言模型的带风险约束群组优化的反事实仲裁
papers.evidence: 群组相对反事实优化，体现多视图结构约束
papers.tldr: 视觉语言模型常面临图像与文本证据冲突或均不支持回答的挑战。现有方法独立优化样本，无法保证反事实一致性。本文提出CARGO-VL框架，将对齐、图像正确、文本正确和两者均错四种证据状态作为一组进行联合优化，结合条件正确性与转换奖励，并利用原对偶控制器平衡不安全回答与过度弃权。同时贡献XMC冲突训练资源。实验表明，该方法在冲突处理、无据回答避免和模态平衡上均优于逐点基线，验证了反事实一致性对多模态证据仲裁的实用性。
papers.abstract: Vision-language systems combine images with retrieved text, but these sources can disagree or jointly fail to support an answer. Reliable models must identify the trustworthy source and abstain when neither is adequate. Existing post-training objectives score instances independently and therefore do not enforce coherent behavior under counterfactual evidenc...

papers.title: Dual-Space Modality Consistency Learning for Universal Cross-Modal Re-Identification
papers.title_zh: 双空间模态一致性学习用于通用跨模态重识别
papers.evidence: 通过双空间一致性学习实现跨模态表征对齐，可迁移至脑机对齐
papers.tldr: 跨模态重识别现有方法多关注空间嵌入一致性，忽略频域模态差异且适用场景受限。本文提出双空间模态一致性学习框架DSMCL，联合空间特征分布对齐和频域辨别一致性正则，通过高斯对齐和身份感知对比学习捕获模态共享与特有线索，实现通用跨模态重识别。该框架即插即用，在五个数据集十七项评估中稳定提升多种基线。
papers.abstract: Cross-modal Re-Identification (ReID) aims to retrieve the same identity across heterogeneous imaging modalities and has been widely studied in visible-infrared person ReID and cross-modal ship ReID. Existing methods have achieved promising performance by learning modality consistency in the spatial embedding space, yet often overlook frequency-domain modali...

papers.title: From Local Learning to Global Prediction Through Layered Surprise Cascades
papers.title_zh: 通过分层意外级联从局部学习走向全局预测
papers.evidence: 生物合理的预测编码机器学习算法；类脑预测表征
papers.tldr: 本文提出一种生物合理的层级预测编码框架，通过局部对比学习和简单活动取消实现全局预测，无需错误编码神经元。基于Forward-Forward算法的循环变体，反转目标使负数据活动增强，从而产生跨层预测表征，捕捉自上而下调制和惊奇信号等皮层计算特征，表明预测编码关键原则可源自简单局部学习规则，为神经科学和机器学习搭建新桥梁。
papers.abstract: Hierarchical predictive coding proposes a compelling hypothesis of brain computation, suggesting that the cortex builds layered predictions to minimize surprise. Yet most models rely on error-coding neurons or generative modeling of unclear biological plausibility. Here, we examine a biologically plausible framework in which the functional goals of predicti...

papers.title: Grid-Preserving Knowledge Distillation: Transferring Convolutional Inductive Bias to Vision Transformers under Data Scarcity
papers.title_zh: 网格保持的知识蒸馏：数据稀缺下将卷积归纳偏置迁移至视觉Transformer
papers.evidence: 保留网格结构的知识蒸馏在数据稀缺时将卷积归纳偏置迁移到视觉Transformer
papers.tldr: 针对ViT在数据稀缺时缺乏卷积归纳偏置的问题，本文提出网格保持的知识蒸馏框架iBKD，通过可学习的归纳偏置注意力模块将学生层映射到教师网格，利用通道与可变形空间注意力和卷积交叉注意力注入结构线索，训练后模型无推理开销，在多个骨干和少样本基准上优于现有方法，数据越少优势越明显。
papers.abstract: Vision Transformers underperform convolutional networks when training data is scarce, and distilling convolutional inductive biases from a CNN teacher is an effective remedy that leaves the deployed model unchanged. General-purpose feature distillation, however, transfers little in this setting. The pooling, flattening, and logit-space projections it inheri...

papers.title: How Far Do Simple Transformations Translate Across Text Embedding Models?
papers.title_zh: 简单变换在跨文本嵌入模型间的迁移程度如何？
papers.evidence: 研究不同表示空间间的线性映射与CKA可比性，可迁移至脑机表征对齐
papers.tldr: 研究探讨简单变换（如线性映射）能否在不同文本嵌入模型间进行表示转换，以实现AI间无需解码的潜在通信。在九种异构模型上评估发现，某些模型对间可通过简单映射恢复语义结构并支持迁移，但多数情况下失败，表明嵌入空间并不具有普遍简单相关性，兼容性受架构、训练目标、池化和数据分布等因素影响。
papers.abstract: We investigate whether simple transformations can translate representations across heterogeneous text embedding models. Understanding how independently trained models organize semantic information is an enabler for AI-to-AI latent communication without decoding into human-readable text. Focusing on lightweight translators such as linear mappings, we test th...

papers.title: Hyperbolic Multimodal Continual Learning
papers.title_zh: 双曲多模态持续学习
papers.evidence: 双曲多模态学习中的跨模态不变性与结构保持
papers.tldr: 该工作从几何视角研究双曲空间中的多模态持续学习，理论证明防止遗忘需要跨模态在共享双曲等距下保持一致性，并揭示遗忘源于语义关系漂移和层级扭曲。提出一个原则性框架，同时保留跨模态关系结构和层级几何，有效适应新任务，在基准测试中取得良好效果。
papers.abstract: Hyperbolic geometry has recently emerged as a powerful representation space for multimodal learning, as it naturally captures hierarchical semantic structure across modalities. Despite this progress, how such representations behave under continual learning poses fundamentally different challenges that remain underexplored. This work provides a geometric per...

papers.title: Learning Deep Modality-Shared Self-Expressiveness for Image Clustering with Textual Information
papers.title_zh: 学习深度模态共享自表达性用于结合文本信息的图像聚类
papers.evidence: 模态共享自表达在图像与文本视图上施加结构约束，契合深度学习中多视图结构约束
papers.tldr: 利用文本信息辅助图像聚类时，直接对齐跨模态表示易破坏模态特有结构。本文提出DeepMORSE，通过模态共享自表达模型捕获跨模态结构并学习保留模态特定子空间的表示，在多个基准上性能提升超3%，且具有强迁移性。
papers.abstract: Leveraging textual information for image clustering has emerged as a promising direction, largely owing to the powerful representations learned by Vision-Language Models (VLMs). Existing approaches typically retrieve a textual counterpart for each image and then refine multimodal representations by directly enforcing cross-modal agreement, e.g., maximizing...

papers.title: Modeling and Interpreting Correlations, Null Distributions and Significance Levels in Neural Tracking of Natural Stimuli
papers.title_zh: 自然刺激神经追踪中相关性、零分布与显著性水平的建模与解读
papers.evidence: 对自然刺激神经追踪中的相关性和显著性水平建模，用于解码/编码
papers.tldr: 神经跟踪相关性受信号统计特性影响，直接比较会产生误导。本文提出以刺激-反应错位作为零假设，利用 Fisher 变换后的正态分布建立半参数模型，仅需 3-5 分钟数据即可估计显著性，并定义归一化跟踪分数，将不同特征和模型置于统一尺度。在 121 名受试者的 EEG 语音数据上，该框架推翻了基于原始相关性的结论，为神经跟踪相关性提供了高效、有原则的解释方法。
papers.abstract: Neural tracking - the time-locking of neural responses to continuous stimuli such as speech, music, and video - is widely used to study how the brain processes natural input. Tracking strength is typically quantified as the correlation between the recorded neural response and the stimulus, decoded and/or encoded through data-driven models, and this correlat...

papers.title: More Accurate, Less Human: Gestalt Grouping in Vision Models
papers.title_zh: 更准确，却更不像人：视觉模型中的格式塔分组
papers.evidence: 行为测试评估包括CLIP在内的视觉模型中类似人类的格式塔分组，符合人类类泛化主题
papers.tldr: 本研究针对视觉模型是否具备人类格式塔分组能力展开系统测试，构建包含四类分组任务的行为测试组，将45个跨五种训练家族的模型与已发表人类感知数据比较，发现与人类一致性揭示传统指标无法区分的感知组织特性，部分封闭模型对齐度远低于基准精度，为可视化研究提供无需新用户研究的可复用审计标尺。
papers.abstract: Human vision organizes what it sees into wholes: same-colored points group into series, similar marks cohere into categories, and shapes complete into recognizable objects. These are the Gestalt operations that visualization design builds on. Whether vision models organize visual content this way has not been systematically tested. We introduce a behavioral...

papers.title: Multi-View Relational Distillation for Spatial Reasoning with Vision-Language Models
papers.title_zh: 面向视觉语言模型空间推理的多视角关系蒸馏
papers.evidence: 多视图关系蒸馏以改进视觉语言模型空间推理
papers.tldr: 本文针对视觉语言模型空间推理脆弱问题，提出多视图关系蒸馏（MVRD）。该方法不直接蒸馏教师特征，而是蒸馏跨视图patch级余弦相似度，既传递几何对应关系又保持学生模型与预训练图文空间的对齐。在代表性VLM上，MVRD提升视觉空间推理性能，超越监督微调和特征蒸馏，接近特征融合方法而参数和延迟更低，并能泛化到3D场景理解任务。
papers.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) have achieved strong image and video understanding, yet their visual-spatial representations remain geometrically fragile, leading to failures in spatial reasoning needed for embodied AI, robotics, and autonomous driving. Prior approaches to geometry grounding either fine-tune VLMs on spatial question answering, which can perpe...

papers.title: ProtoGIB-Workload: Learning Workload-Specific Neural Topology Prototypes across Subjects
papers.title_zh: ProtoGIB-Workload：学习跨被试的工作负荷特异性神经拓扑原型
papers.evidence: 跨被试脑电拓扑对齐，作为提升泛化的人口神经先验
papers.tldr: 针对脑电心理负荷识别跨被试泛化难题，提出ProtoGIB-Workload框架。该方法通过随机图信息瓶颈压缩功能连接图，去除冗余，并结合类条件拓扑稳定器利用固定电极坐标，促进同类负荷跨被试边生成一致性。在三个数据集上严格留一被试验证，跨被试Macro-F1平均提升5.15%，有效提取稳定神经连接模式。
papers.abstract: Reliable electroencephalography (EEG)-based mental workload recognition is crucial for adaptive human-centered systems, yet practical deployment requires models to generalize to users unseen during training. Although functional connectivity graphs are widely adopted to capture workload-related neural interactions, they inherently entangle task-relevant stru...

papers.title: Sheaf-Based Federated Representation Learning
papers.title_zh: 基于Sheaf的联邦表示学习
papers.evidence: 基于层束的几何对齐正则化来对齐异构表征
papers.tldr: 针对异构联邦学习中数据分布、模态、架构、潜在维度及目标差异，提出基于层（Sheaf）的联邦表示学习框架 SFRL。该框架通过可学习的层限制映射和流形约束几何对齐正则化，不假设共享全局潜在空间，利用小规模共享样本实现通信高效的去中心化训练。实验表明，SFRL 在语义通信合作分类任务中优于基线方法，并对潜在空间维度压缩具有更强鲁棒性。
papers.abstract: Heterogeneous federated systems require agents to learn and exchange informative representations despite differences in data distributions, sensing modalities, model architectures, latent dimensionalities, and local learning objectives. To address this challenge, we propose Sheaf-based Federated Representation Learning (SFRL), a general framework that joint...

papers.title: A Framework for Joint Affine and Diffeomorphic Image Registration
papers.title_zh: 联合仿射与微分同胚图像配准框架
papers.evidence: 联合仿射与微分同胚配准,可迁移至跨被试fMRI对齐
papers.tldr: 传统图像配准通常先估计仿射变换再固定进行微分同胚变形，两步顺序易导致次优结果。本文提出联合仿射-微分同胚框架，基于大变形模型在单一优化中同时估计全局仿射与局部微分同胚运动，并提供全仿射和分解仿射两种模型。通过渐进仿射丰富化与变分加权实现平滑粗到细优化。在2D合成数据和3D脑MRI上，该方法在Dice重叠上优于CARL、uniGradI-CON及FLIRT+LDDMM顺序基线，避免病理变形。
papers.abstract: Anatomical image registration commonly relies on a sequential pipeline where an affine alignment is estimated first and then held fixed while a non-rigid diffeomorphic deformation is applied. This two-step process often leads to suboptimal results, as the initial stage can absorb local deformations, biasing the residual passed to the diffeomorphic registrat...

papers.title: Beyond Residual Connections: Manifold-Constrained Hyper-Connections for Robust Speaker Representation Learning
papers.title_zh: 超越残差连接：面向鲁棒说话人表示学习的流形约束超连接
papers.evidence: 流形约束超连接作为深度学习中的结构约束方法
papers.tldr: 针对深度说话人识别模型中标准残差连接信息路径单一、表征能力受限的问题，本文提出流形约束超连接（mHC），将残差路径重塑为多流进化并通过双重随机矩阵混合信息，利用Sinkhorn-Knopp迭代保证能量守恒以稳定梯度并缓解信号退化。在VoxCeleb1上替换多种骨干网络进行实验，mHC一致提升了说话人识别性能，为鲁棒说话人表征学习提供了有效方案。
papers.abstract: Residual connections are fundamental to deep speaker recogni- tion models, such as ECAPA-TDNN and ResNet. However, standard identity mapping limits information flow to a sin- gle path, constraining representation capacity. We introduce Manifold-Constrained Hyper-Connections (mHC), reformulat- ing residual paths as a multi-stream evolution where informa- tio...

papers.title: BioKD: Selective Physiology-to-Video Knowledge Distillation via Reliability Gate for Emotion Recognition
papers.title_zh: BioKD：通过可靠性门控的选择性生理信号到视频知识蒸馏用于情感识别
papers.evidence: 基于可靠门控的生理-视频知识蒸馏，处理跨被试变异性
papers.tldr: 针对视频情感识别在模糊行为线索下性能受限及生理信号部署困难的问题，本文提出BioKD框架，利用生理信号作为特权信息通过可靠性门控机制和渐进蒸馏策略，指导视频模型学习鲁棒情感表征，仅在推理时使用视频输入。实验表明该方法在DEAP和AMIGOS数据集上显著优于基线，有效抑制不可靠监督的负迁移，并无需额外推理开销。
papers.abstract: To address the limitations of video-based emotion recognition under ambiguous or socially masked behavioral cues, as well as the poor deployability of physiological signals, this paper proposes a reliability-aware physiology-to-video knowledge distillation framework, termed BioKD. The proposed framework leverages physiological signals as privileged informat...

papers.title: Cross-View Action Consistency for Camera-Robust Vision-Language-Action Policies
papers.title_zh: 跨视图动作一致性实现相机鲁棒的视觉-语言-动作策略
papers.evidence: 跨视角动作一致性约束，可迁移至多视图结构约束学习
papers.tldr: 该研究解决视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略在场景摄像头移动时性能下降的问题，仅使用RGB图像、语言指令和本体感觉。针对基于流匹配的VLA，提出跨视角动作一致性正则化，通过构建动作等价视角对，让模型在不同视角下预测一致的动作流速度场，从而提升对摄像头变化的鲁棒性。在LIBERO-Plus基准上，成功率提升7.4个百分点，真实机器人实验也验证了有效性。
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies fine-tuned from a fixed scene camera can fail when the camera is moved, even when the task, objects, language, and robot state are unchanged. We study scene-camera viewpoint robustness using only a scene RGB image, language, and proprioception, without camera labels, extrinsics, depth, or point-cloud inputs. The wrist s...

papers.title: EgoHieraLoc: A Cortically Inspired Hierarchical Segmentation-Guided Framework for Egocentric Visual Query Localization
papers.title_zh: EgoHieraLoc：一种受皮层启发的层次化分割引导的自我中心视觉查询定位框架
papers.evidence: 皮层启发的分层分割与多视图整合
papers.tldr: 针对第一视角视频中视觉查询定位（VQL）物体边界模糊且全局上下文难以细粒度引导的问题，本文借鉴人类视觉层级处理机制，提出统一框架EgoHieraLoc，包含判别解析、查询感知和区域自适应三模块，并结合几何-语义联合置信度扩展到3D，在2D和3D基准上达到最优性能。
papers.abstract: Visual query localization (VQL) aims to retrieve and re-localize a queried object in egocentric videos, yet remains challenging when object boundaries are ambiguous and global context cannot effectively guide fine-grained localization. Human vision handles such ambiguity through a hierarchical process: it rapidly screens foreground candidates, selectively a...

papers.title: Flow-Map Distillation on Relation Manifolds for Image Restoration
papers.title_zh: 关系流形上的流映射蒸馏用于图像复原
papers.evidence: 关系流形蒸馏，在表征间施加结构约束
papers.tldr: 针对图像恢复中知识蒸馏忽略知识传递动态性的问题，本文提出关系流形上的流映射蒸馏方法FoRM。该方法将关系知识传递建模为连续流映射问题，学习流映射算子直接预测任意时刻的关系状态，并通过安全半群一致性约束和端点锚定损失保证自洽性与稳定性。在超分、去雨等五个任务上，FoRM以约50%的训练方差降低和一致性能增益超越现有方法。
papers.abstract: Knowledge distillation for image restoration typically aligns intermediate features or relation matrices between teacher and student networks as static targets, ignoring the dynamic structure of the knowledge transfer process. papers.title: Gaze Behavior in Visual World Experiments Can be Modeled With Off-the-shelf Language-Vision Encoders
papers.title_zh: 视觉世界实验中的注视行为可以用现成的语言-视觉编码器建模
papers.evidence: 使用CLIP类编码器预测视觉世界实验中的注视行为，对齐视觉-语言表征与人类感知
papers.tldr: 神经语言模型在计算心理语言学中多聚焦于单模态输入，忽视了视觉世界实验等多模态范式。本文提出利用现成的CLIP多模态双编码器及双模态归因方法，预测视觉世界研究中的注视行为。该方法无需生成架构或微调，即能复现显示人类预测性处理的经典英文实验，表明现有多模态语言-视觉编码器可有效建模人类在视听输入下的语言处理。
papers.abstract: The recent advances in neural language models have also spurred much work in computational psycholinguistics, asking whether neural LMs are also promising models of human language processing. However, work has been overwhelmingly focused on the unimodal case of written or spoken language. In contrast, multimodal experimental paradigms, like visual world stu...

papers.title: Integrating Implicit and Explicit Relational Biases through Graph-Based Multiple Instance Learning: A Case Study in Skin Lesion Diagnosis
papers.title_zh: 通过基于图的多示例学习整合隐式和显式关系偏置：皮肤病变诊断案例研究
papers.evidence: 通过基于图的多示例学习整合隐式与显式关系偏置
papers.tldr: 该研究针对皮肤病变诊断，提出结合隐式与显式关系偏置的图多实例学习框架。以EfficientNetB3为基线，通过掩码自编码器学习补丁间隐式关系，再构建网格、随机、k近邻等图拓扑进行显式消息传递。在ISIC-2018和ISIC-2019数据集上，融合方法分别将平衡准确率从76.17%提升至79.27%和从59.84%提升至60.67%，证明双重关系建模的有效性。
papers.abstract: Relational inductive biases are essential for capturing structural dependencies among data. This study investigates a dual-level relational framework for image classification, bridging the gap between implicit representation learning and explicit structural modelling. We begin by establishing a baseline using an EfficientNetB3 architecture. To move beyond s...

papers.title: MGMCL: Multi-Granularity Manifold Contrastive Learning With Neural ODEs for Cross-Subject EEG Emotion Recognition
papers.title_zh: MGMCL：面向跨被试脑电情绪识别的多粒度流形对比学习与神经常微分方程
papers.evidence: 跨被试EEG表征对齐与多粒度流形对比约束
papers.tldr: 针对跨受试者脑电情绪识别中个体差异大及情感连续性被忽略的问题，提出多粒度流形对比学习框架（MGMCL），在SPD黎曼流形上学习连续情绪表示，结合神经常微分方程建模动态，并通过Gromov-Wasserstein对齐实现跨受试者泛化，在三个数据集上取得领先性能。
papers.abstract: Cross-subject electroencephalogram (EEG)-based emotion recognition remains challenging due to substantial inter-individual variability and discrete formulation that overlooks affective continuity. Existing methods operate in Euclidean space and focus on marginal distribution alignment, failing to preserve the semantic structure of emotions across subjects....

papers.title: Multi-Perspective Triad Interaction Graph Neural Network for Cognitive Distortion Detection
papers.title_zh: 用于认知扭曲检测的多视角三元交互图神经网络
papers.evidence: 深度学习中的多视角三元交互与图结构约束
papers.tldr: 针对认知扭曲检测忽视心理结构的不足，本文提出MTI-GNN模型，利用Beck认知三元组（自我、世界、未来）作为互补视角。通过LLM分解话语为三视角并构建相似图，经多视角GNN编码后，由三元组交互模块和原型引导融合捕获跨视角依赖。在4种语言、10类扭曲的9764样本上，模型显著优于所有监督方法及8种生成模型，消融实验验证了三视角的关键贡献，专家评估初步证实其心理维度对齐。
papers.abstract: Cognitive distortion detection is a key task in computational mental health, yet existing approaches often overlook the psychological structure of distorted thoughts. We propose MTI-GNN (Multi-Perspective Triad Interaction Graph Neural Network), which models Beck's cognitive triad---negative views of the self, world, and future---as complementary perspectiv...

papers.title: Personalized Federated Learning via Variance-Aware Nonparametric Empirical Bayes
papers.title_zh: 基于方差感知非参数经验贝叶斯的个性化联邦学习
papers.evidence: 通过非参数经验贝叶斯估计共享人口先验以改进模型泛化
papers.tldr: 本文提出面向异构客户端个性化联邦学习的方差感知非参数经验贝叶斯（VANEB）方法。利用局部M估计的渐近正态性，将局部参数视为带参数依赖方差的噪声观测，通过非参数极大似然估计共享先验，并推导广义Tweedie公式。给出非渐近误差界，并在深度网络上提出VANEB-head和VANEB-FT，在MNIST和CIFAR-10上验证性能。
papers.abstract: We develop a new approach to Personalized Federated Learning across heterogeneous clients using Nonparametric Empirical Bayes (NPEB). Leveraging the asymptotic normality of local parameter estimates obtained from Empirical Risk Minimization or M-estimation, our method formulates these estimates as noisy observations to estimate an unknown shared prior via N...

papers.title: Rectifying Geometric Misalignment: Online Source-Free Adaptation for Class-Imbalanced EEG
papers.title_zh: 纠正几何错位：面向类别不平衡脑电的在线无源自适应方法
papers.evidence: 面向脑解码的EEG跨被试无监督域适应
papers.tldr: 脑机接口中，黎曼对齐方法假设类别平衡，但在线场景下标签分布动态变化导致几何错位。本文提出OSPDIM，一种无源在线域适应框架，通过在切线空间映射中引入流形约束偏置，利用信息最大化在线纠正不平衡引起的偏斜。模拟和运动想象实验表明，OSPDIM显著优于标准基线，在严重类别不平衡下提供鲁棒解决方案。
papers.abstract: Electroencephalography (EEG) based Brain-Computer Interfaces (BCIs) often require unsupervised domain adaptation (UDA) to generalize across subjects and sessions. While Riemannian alignment methods like the Riemannian Centering Transformation (RCT) are effective for handling covariate shifts, they implicitly assume balanced class priors. papers.title: Three Necessary Principles for Self-Supervised Visual Representation Learning
papers.title_zh: 自监督视觉表征学习的三个必要原则
papers.evidence: 提出多视图语义不变性与表征约束作为自监督学习必要原则
papers.tldr: 研究提出自监督视觉表示学习必须满足三项互补原则：语义不变性（观察）、空间预测（预测）和表征非退化（正则化）。理论证明缺少任一原则会导致退化解或信号缺失，且任何两者无法替代第三者。将主流方法统一为一个能量分解框架，并通过受控实验验证理论，包含块检索任务评估预测的空间效果。
papers.abstract: We argue that learning visual representations without labels requires a training signal jointly complete across three non-overlapping objectives: semantic invariance across augmented views, patch-level spatial prediction, and representational non-degeneracy. We formalize these as the observation, prediction, and regularization principles and prove (i) that...

papers.title: When Is a Steerable Concept Representation Real? Measurement Confounds in a Cross-Family Audit of Neuroscience Parallels in LLMs
papers.title_zh: 可操控概念表征何时才是真实的？跨模型系列审计大语言模型中神经科学类比的测量混淆
papers.evidence: 审计LLM中神经科学类比的测量混淆，为脑机表征对齐提供方法保障
papers.tldr: 大语言模型常被报道具有类人神经特征，但多基于单一模型和敏感测量。本研究审计5个家族17个模型、四个范式，发现概念引导随规模涌现的趋势源于未校准测量；纠正后无显著趋势但仍显著。其余现象混合。表明AI神经科学的主要障碍是缺乏可比测量和充分控制。
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly reported to exhibit human-like neural and cognitive signatures, including concept cells, mental number lines, and cognitive maps.
